description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters for attendance reports within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a date range filter and adds specific fields such as employee numbers, job title ID, subunit ID, and employment status ID, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering attendance reports, with properties for employee numbers, job title, subunit, and employment status, extending date range filters.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers.
